author: Home Repair Tutor
description: I need to waterproof this shower pony wall. I’m using a Schluter KERDI-KERECK inside corner to waterproof this outside corner. I apply thin-set then trowel it with a KERDI trowel and embed the corner. Many thanks to Schluter for providing materials for my client’s renovation
title: Shower Pony Wall Waterproofing Tip - #shorts #showerremodel #ponywall #brandpartner
